hypotheses.statement: Equivalent deterministic replay can regenerate engineering-equivalent geometry without preserving OCCT IsSame face identity.
hypotheses.falsification: Independent replay preserves a complete and stable one-to-one OCCT face identity mapping across process restart/reconstruction and that mapping remains meaningful after split, merge, replacement and unification.

hypotheses.statement: OCCT Generated/Modified/Removed history provides useful local ancestry evidence, but a programme-level lineage graph is needed to compose manufacturing semantics across regenerated topology and backend replacement.
hypotheses.falsification: OCCT operation history alone provides backend-independent durable semantic identities for all tested split, merge, replacement and replay cases.

hypotheses.statement: A canonical operation/envelope lineage proof can identify exact retraces as candidates for geometry recomputation elision while preserving the journal event.
hypotheses.falsification: The repeated-finishing fixture changes committed material despite identical canonical target body, setup, tool revision and removal-envelope semantics.

hypotheses.statement: When multiple descendants are semantically indistinguishable, a correct naming model must preserve ambiguity rather than invent an arbitrary stable topology name.
hypotheses.falsification: A backend-independent deterministic semantic discriminator exists for every deliberately symmetric ambiguous fixture without adding information absent from manufacturing intent.

worker_cases.purpose: Compare engineering-equivalent independent reconstruction with OCCT IsSame topology identity.
Measure one-to-many ancestry when a through cut divides one material body.
Measure replacement/modification ancestry across sequential overlapping removal envelopes.
Measure many-to-one history when coincident-domain faces are reconciled/unified.
Test geometry equivalence and topology/history behavior for a repeated finishing envelope.

semantic_cases.purpose: Require an explicit ambiguous lineage relation when manufacturing semantics do not distinguish two symmetric descendants.
Construct the minimum semantic proof tuple for a candidate exact-retrace geometry reuse decision.
